results.name: A new owner has private disabled membership settings and an explicitly configured stub gateway
Membership management rejects anonymous reads, missing CSRF, foreign Origin and changed accounts
The owning broadcaster publishes its real monthly plan through a versioned server update
Plan update receipts reconcile committed writes and stale versions cannot overwrite them
The public membership offer exposes the server price without billing credentials
Missing or unsupported recurring-payment consent is rejected before any provider request
Self-subscription and client-supplied payment amounts are rejected before provider contact
A stale or invented offer version cannot prepare a checkout with a different price
Rejected membership preparation does not contact the provider
Preparing a real account membership returns a pending authorization and server-bound checkout identity without entitlement
Repeated signup and its receipt resolve one durable subscription without a second order
A different account cannot read, authorize or cancel the subscriber’s private membership
A tampered checkout customer identity is refused before billing-key issuance
The authentic account callback is accepted for asynchronous billing-key issuance and first charging
A provider-accepted charge with a lost response remains unconfirmed and grants no fabricated membership
Repeating the same authorization cannot issue or charge again while confirmation is unknown
The subscriber can explicitly request lookup-only reconciliation
Lookup of the same persisted order confirms one paid month without a second provider charge
The account payment history contains the confirmed monthly amount and excludes authorization secrets
Only the owning broadcaster sees its actual active subscriber and private detail
Changing the offer price affects future signups while the existing subscriber keeps the paid price snapshot
A provider HTTP400 ALREADY_PROCESSING_REQUEST remains unconfirmed without another charge or fabricated renewed access
A processing-error renewal can request lookup of its existing order
Lookup resolves the HTTP400 processing response into one new monthly cycle with a distinct stable order/idempotency tuple and the original price
A stale membership version cannot cancel a newer paid cycle
Cancellation stops the next monthly charge while preserving the already paid membership period
Cancellation has a durable receipt and actually deletes its billing key through the authenticated provider route
Repeating cancellation neither refunds the paid month nor creates another charge
Subsequent scheduler polls create no renewal charge after cancellation removes the next-charge deadline
